c74object.name: flux.artnet.receive
c74object.digest: Receive Art-Net DMX data over UDP
c74object.description: Receive Art-Net DMX data over UDP. Outlet i corresponds to universes[i] and emits 512 integers 0-255, or normalized floats 0.0-1.0 with floatoutput 1.

method.name: bang
method.digest: Output the current frame for every configured universe immediately
method.description: Output the current frame for every configured universe immediately. During blackout, bang outputs zeros.

method.name: blackout
method.description: blackout 1 immediately outputs zeros on every outlet. The receiver keeps listening and tracking incoming data, but suppresses live output. In fixed-rate mode it outputs zeros at @framerate; in change mode it outputs zeros once and bang outputs zeros. blackout 0 immediately outputs the latest stored frames and resumes normal output.

attribute.name: floatoutput
attribute.digest: When 1, outlets emit normalized floats 0.0-1.0 instead of integers 0-255
attribute.description: When 1, outlets emit normalized floats 0.0-1.0 instead of integers 0-255.

attribute.name: framerate
attribute.digest: Output frame rate in frames per second
attribute.description: Output frame rate in frames per second. 0 emits only when received data changes; a positive value emits every configured universe at that fixed rate. Valid range: 0-1000.

attribute.name: quiet
attribute.digest: When 1, suppress error messages in the Max console
attribute.description: When 1, suppress error messages in the Max console.

attribute.name: universes
attribute.digest: Ordered list of Art-Net Port-Addresses (0-32767) to receive
attribute.description: Ordered list of Art-Net Port-Addresses (0-32767) to receive. One outlet is created per entry. This attribute is creation-time only.
